messages:
maria: Morning all — quick async check-in:
- Did: onboarded llama-2-13b-q8 to staging and ran smoke evals with promptset v3
- Blocker: intermittent 503s when replaying sessions; suspect KV-cache eviction mismatch for sequences >1024
- Today: dig into serving logs, open PR for eval-cli retry/backoff, re-run full promptset tonight
cc @kevin @liam

kevin: Thanks — can you paste one failing eval_id? I’ll review the PR after breakfast.

maria: eval_id: 20260316-llama13b-run42
log excerpt:
```
ERROR 503: response truncated; kv_cache_lookup failed for key 0x7f2a...; seq_len 1280
```
Also saw "batch_size 8 -> OOM" once.

liam: I’ve seen this with q8 kernels before. Hypothesis: padding -> different kernel selection -> cache offsets shift. Tagging @sana to try a no-cache rerun.

sana: Kicked off rerun with cache disabled: `./run_eval --model llama-2-13b-q8 --no-cache --batch 1 --promptset v3`
Quick result: passed 5/5 smoke cases, no 503s. Looks like cache boundary indeed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployed model/llama-2-13b-q8 to staging (sha=abc123) — 2026-03-16T09:12:00Z

maria: Great. Action items:
- @kevin: review PR #789 (eval-cli retry/backoff)
- @liam: add a unit test for kv-cache boundary (seq lengths 1024, 1025, 1280)
- @sana: run full promptset v3 tonight and post results (include token counts + failure ids)
Goal: green full run before tomorrow morning demo.

kevin: On it. Quick note: make sure retries are jittered so we don't amplify load during transient failures. :+1:

liam: Will add tests and push by EOD.

sana: Will post full-run summary in this thread when finished.

maria: Awesome — no other blockers from me. If anyone spots regressions on prod routes, please ping #eng-oncall and tag me. :thumbsup:
